title: Opinions & discourse chunks (B1)
note: Last teaching unit before the checks. I'd say, in my view, on the other hand, it depends — plus the first hedging buds. Chunks, not grammar: they are learned whole. Feeds the b1_finale Use stage. First draft 2026-09-02. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: **on the other hand** and **then again** carried the SAME Czech prompt (*na druhou stranu*), so a Match board could show two tiles a student has no way to tell apart. *then again* is now *ale zase*. · The **I'm not sure but** tile had no comma while every real sentence does, which is why its own frame never gapped; the tile is *I'm not sure, but* now. · sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma. E10: Use is use_mode rewrite, 12 items — and on a discourse pack the paraphrase is exactly the job: *I think* → in my view, *But* → on the other hand, *nearly* → more or less. · C48: card 0's prose is a three-row table — what you want to do, and what you say. · Pool-checked against everything taught before trunk_opinions_b1 — 0 unknown types. · 2026-09-04: seven rewrite items — the discourse markers lost their comma in the swap, so the prompt now carries the same comma, and the paraphrase sits in the marker's own slot. · 2026-09-05 B1 loop: sentence texture. 12 of 36 Use sentences were FLAT or THIN under check_sentence_texture.py — a discourse chunk carries no clause of its own, so the sentence behind it has to, and twelve of these had nothing after the chunk but a bare `NP + be + ADJ`. All 12 rewritten so the opinion is about something, with a clause and two or more already-taught words. 0/36 fail now.

intro.title: Ways of saying what you think
intro.body_cz: Nejsou to nová fakta, ale fráze, kterými říkáš svůj názor. Angličtina jimi zmírňuje tvrzení, připouští druhou stranu nebo ukazuje míru jistoty. Zbytek věty zůstává normální.

rows: I'd say · in my view · if you ask me
on the other hand · then again · whereas
I suppose · more or less · to some extent

intro.title: You will use these words in
frames: On the other hand, … · *Na druhou stranu …*
I'm not sure, but … · *Nejsem si jistý, ale …*
intro.note: These are **chunks** — learn them whole, do not build them word by word.
intro.note_cz: Tohle jsou ustálené obraty. Uč se je celé.

sentences.en: I'd say the second option is better because it costs less.
sentences.cz: Řekl bych, že druhá možnost je lepší, protože stojí míň.
accepts: I'd say the second option is better because it costs less

sentences.en: In my view, the price is too high for a flat which needs so much work.
sentences.cz: Podle mého názoru je ta cena moc vysoká na byt, který potřebuje tolik práce.
accepts: In my view, the price is too high for a flat which needs so much work

sentences.en: On the other hand, the train is faster than the bus.
sentences.cz: Na druhou stranu je vlak rychlejší než autobus.
accepts: On the other hand, the train is faster than the bus

sentences.en: It depends on the weather, because we can't walk in the rain.
sentences.cz: Záleží na počasí, protože v dešti chodit nemůžeme.
accepts: It depends on the weather, because we can't walk in the rain
It depends on the weather, because we cannot walk in the rain

sentences.en: To be honest, I didn't like the film although everybody says it is great.
sentences.cz: Upřímně řečeno se mi ten film nelíbil, i když všichni říkají, že je skvělý.
accepts: To be honest, I didn't like the film although everybody says it is great
To be honest, I did not like the film although everybody says it is great

sentences.en: I'm not sure, but I think he's right about the new teacher.
sentences.cz: Nejsem si jistý, ale myslím, že má pravdu ohledně toho nového učitele.
accepts: I'm not sure, but I think he's right about the new teacher
I am not sure, but I think he is right about the new teacher

sentences.en: Overall, the trip was a success, although the hotel was cold.
sentences.cz: Celkově byl ten výlet úspěch, i když byl hotel studený.
accepts: Overall, the trip was a success, although the hotel was cold

sentences.en: As far as I know, the shop is closed.
sentences.cz: Pokud vím, ten obchod je zavřený.
accepts: As far as I know, the shop is closed

sentences.en: It seems to me that nobody read the report.
sentences.cz: Zdá se mi, že tu zprávu nikdo nečetl.
accepts: It seems to me that nobody read the report

sentences.en: Personally, I would take the train because the road to Vienna is always full.

sentences.en: The way I see it, we have no choice because the other flat is gone.

sentences.en: On balance, the new system is better than the old one.

sentences.en: I reckon the shop will be closed by six.

sentences.en: I'm convinced that she will get the job.

sentences.en: I'd agree that the second flat is nicer.

sentences.en: Then again, the bus is cheaper than the train.
sentences.cz: Ale zase je autobus levnější než vlak.

sentences.en: My brother likes the city, whereas I prefer the countryside.
sentences.cz: Bratr má rád město, zatímco já mám radši venkov.

sentences.en: The problem is that nobody wants to work at night.

sentences.en: The good thing is that the school is close to our flat.
sentences.cz: Dobré je, že škola je blízko našeho bytu.
accepts: The good thing is that the school is close to our flat

sentences.en: In some ways, the old office was better than the new one.
sentences.cz: V něčem byla ta stará kancelář lepší než ta nová.

sentences.en: That said, the food was very good although the service was slow.

sentences.en: It's not that simple, because the money comes from the city.
sentences.cz: Není to tak jednoduché, protože peníze jdou od města.
accepts: It's not that simple, because the money comes from the city

sentences.en: Having said that, I would go again next year if the price stays the same.

accepts: It might be cheaper to fly than to take the train

sentences.en: The film was sort of funny, but nobody laughed.
sentences.cz: Ten film byl tak nějak vtipný, ale nikdo se nesmál.
accepts: The film was sort of funny, but nobody laughed

sentences.en: I was kind of tired after the journey.

accepts: I was kind of tired after the journey

sentences.en: In a way, he was right about the new teacher, although nobody agreed then.
sentences.cz: V jistém smyslu měl o té nové učitelce pravdu, i když s ním tehdy nikdo nesouhlasil.

sentences.en: I tend to think the first plan was better.
